messages:
deploy-bot: [deploy] image build started -> registry=gcr.io/redwood-inference/staging, tag=release-2026-03-20, commit=ab12cd34

deploy-bot: build id=ci-4321, builder=kaniko, multiarch=true, digest=(pending)

alex_r: seeing repeated 503s from gcr during push, stacktrace in CI logs

alex_r: snippet:
```
INFO: Pushing layer 3/7
ERROR: received unexpected HTTP status: 503 Service Unavailable
Retrying in 5s (attempt 2/5)
```

maria_k: ugh. Is this a transient rate limit or something with our parallel push?

deploy-bot: retry attempt 3/5 -> backoff=10s (push throttled by registry) :warning:

kevin_m: can we fall back to single-arch push (amd64) to finish canary? multiarch pushes double concurrent uploads. Thoughts?

maria_k: +1 to single-arch for the canary so we don't block the release window. We'll still need a multiarch manifest later.

sarah_ops: hold prod rollout for now. CI will mark staging image ready only when full manifest exists. I'll update the change window and notify SRE.

alex_r: creating temporary pinned tag to previous stable digest in case we need immediate rollback:
```
gcloud container images add-tag gcr.io/redwood-inference/staging@sha256:9f8e7d6c stable-pin:2026-03-20-rollback --quiet
```

kevin_m: nice. Also create a note in release notes: link -> https://docs.internal/release-notes/2026-03-20 (i'll add a blurb)

oncall-bot: @sarah_ops incident alert: registry throttling affecting pushes in us-central1. Severity: low -> monitoring watch

deploy-bot: switching to single-arch push (amd64) for canary: pushing tag=release-2026-03-20-amd64

deploy-bot: push attempt 1/3 (amd64) -> progress: 7/7 layers uploaded, signing image with cosign

deploy-bot: push success -> gcr.io/redwood-inference/staging:release-2026-03-20-amd64, digest=sha256:4b2c9a5d, size=512MB :tada:

maria_k: canary in staging up, running smoke tests now (will report back)

kevin_m: i'll kick off manifest creation once smoke green. Command I'll run:
```
gcloud container images add-tag gcr.io/redwood-inference/staging:release-2026-03-20-amd64 gcr.io/redwood-inference/staging:release-2026-03-20 --quiet
```

alex_r: smoke tests passed. No regressions on core flows.

deploy-bot: creating multiarch manifest (deferred) -> will retry overnight with reduced concurrency to avoid throttling. Scheduled job id=regpush-2026-03-20-01

sarah_ops: I'll push a short update to #announcements that prod rollout is delayed and we're pinning rollback tag. cc @eng-ops

maria_k: follow-up action: open ticket to request registry quota bump or whitelist for our CI runners.

kevin_m: thanks everyone. we'll proceed with canary -> keep manifest creation separate. I'll update the release notes and add the rollback tag details. :white_check_mark:
